lines.en: Who made the only funny joke that evening and why?
lines.cn: 谁在那个晚上讲了唯一一个有趣的笑话？为什么呢？

lines.en: People will do anything to see a free show--even if it is a bad one.
lines.cn: 人们会不惜一切代价去看一场免费的演出——哪怕这场演出很糟糕。

lines.en: When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented
lines.cn: 当消息传开，说将有一档喜剧节目播出时……

lines.en: at our local cinema by the P. and U. Bird Seed Company, we all rushed to see it.
lines.cn: 在我们当地的电影院（该电影院由 P. and U. Bird Seed 公司运营），我们都纷纷赶去观看这部电影。

lines.en: We had to queue for hours to get in and there must have been several hundred people present just before the show began.
lines.cn: 我们不得不排队等待数小时才能进入现场；在演出开始前，现场肯定有几百人。

lines.en: Unfortunately, the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen.
lines.cn: 不幸的是，这部剧是我们看过的最无聊的剧集之一。

lines.en: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed,
lines.cn: 那些未能被录取的人不必感到失望。

lines.en: as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
lines.cn: 许多本应出席的艺术家都没有来。

lines.en: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser at the beginning of the programme.
lines.cn: 那天晚上我们听到的唯一有趣的内容，来自节目开始时出现的那位广告商。

lines.en: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.
lines.cn: 他显然非常紧张，在麦克风前尴尬地站了好几分钟。

lines.en: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
lines.cn: 他一开口，所有人立刻都笑了起来。

lines.en: We all know what the poor man should have said,
lines.cn: 我们都知道那个穷人本应该说什么。

lines.en: but what he actually said was: 'This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company. Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
lines.cn: 但他实际上说的是：“这是‘Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company’。女士们、先生们，晚上好！”
